decision: Phase C freeze decision (human, 2026-10-28): exclude the third-party AndroidX jars from the submission and the commit; commit all other NS07 evidence
reason: During F5 the executor extracted the classes.jar of three AndroidX libraries (Google, Apache-2.0) and their resolved build variants into f-fix3/ only as the javap classpath for its bytecode reading. They are third-party binaries, reproducible from the Gradle cache and Google Maven; the F10 run later forbade copying such binaries into evidence. The javap output that F5's analysis relies on stays committed as text (f-fix3/bytecode-*.stdout.log and resolved-*.stdout.log with their receipts); no F5 result, analysis or checkpoint names a jar as evidence. Receipts and porcelain listings that mention a jar path keep their original text.
retained: Byte-identical copies are kept outside the repository in the coordinator's local NS07 backup (not committed); the SHA-256 values below were verified against those copies before the originals were removed.
